stem: A resident pharmacy closed yesterday after transferring its controlled-substance stock lawfully. Which post-closure duties remain? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed premises.
Submit the original licenses and controlled-substance registration within 14 days.
Attest to the lawful disposal or transfer of controlled substances.
Wait one year before notifying the Board.
Complete the required post-closure submission within 14 days after closing.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Submit the original licenses and controlled-substance registration within 14 days. Attest to the lawful disposal or transfer of controlled substances. Complete the required post-closure submission within 14 days after closing.

choice_analysis.A: Not supported: Keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed premises.
choice_analysis.B: Supported: Submit the original licenses and controlled-substance registration within 14 days.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Attest to the lawful disposal or transfer of controlled substances.
choice_analysis.D: Not supported: Wait one year before notifying the Board.
choice_analysis.E: Supported: Complete the required post-closure submission within 14 days after closing.

related_facts: Within 14 days after closure, the resident pharmacy submits original licenses and controlled-substance registration plus an attestation of lawful controlled-substance disposal or transfer.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed premises.'

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Controlled substances and credentials after pharmacy closure
Reject nearby rules whose schedule, trigger, deadline, or actor differs from Closure disposition
